segments.name: Real Estate Investments
segments.description: Owns and leases senior housing and medical facilities to third-party operators under triple-net leases and earns interest income from financing arrangements.
segments.evidence: In our Real Estate Investments segment, our revenues primarily relate to triple-net leases with third-party operators at our properties.

segments.name: Senior Housing Operating Portfolio
segments.description: Owns senior housing communities operated by third-party managers on its behalf, generating resident fees and services revenue.
segments.evidence: Our SHOP segment is comprised of senior housing communities from which we generate revenues from resident fees and services on each unit.

revenueModel.text: NHI is paid rent by triple-net tenants, interest by borrowers on financing arrangements, and resident fees and services by residents of its SHOP communities.
revenueModel.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, our total revenues were $375.6 million, an increase of 12.1% over the prior year, consisting of $271.6 million of rental income, $80.1 million of resident fees and services and $24.0 million of interest and other income.
